description: AsyncAPI 3.1 common-kernel plus payloadless plaintext HTTP synthesis and coverage.

scenarios.description: An east-only channel contributes exactly its east cell; exact inventory and excluded disposition have separate owners.
A broken selected-target closure is invalid at its operation owner while an unrelated usable cell remains exactly inventoried and excluded.
An absent root operations map emits no ghost operation or binding.
An explicit empty root operations map emits no ghost operation or binding.
A component operation is not a root inventory target and emits no ghost operation.
Malformed channel and server owners are separately invalid while a usable server/channel sibling cell survives excluded.
Two servers and two operations produce the exact three-cell cartesian inventory induced by channel membership.
Known-looking HTTP WebSocket MQTT and Kafka protocol and binding material remains excluded and emits zero operations and bindings.
Explicit empty channel servers creates one excluded cell for every usable root server.
Root Reference Object slots resolve to component values while escaped root slot names remain the selector identity.
A pure component operation-reference cycle is invalid while an independent usable sibling cell survives as excluded.
A usable root operation with no addressable root Server cell has one exact excluded target entry and emits no operation or binding.
A component-authored channel preserves a root-slot cell and separately excludes a direct component-only server membership without referent inference.
Nested relative external Operation and Channel resources rebase independently and yield the exact root-server cell.
A well-formed UTF-16LE external Operation resource is an excluded encoding target rather than an invalid owner and emits no ghost output.
Reached invalid component Operation Channel and Server keys have exact owner pointers while a usable sibling cell survives.
One invalid shared component Channel owner is repeated only for its two distinct affected root operation keys while a good sibling survives.
Malformed bytes in a reached external Operation resource produce a canonical confined external invalid owner while a good local cell survives.
A missing Server reference invalidates its exact Channel owner while an unrelated usable sibling cell survives.
External-authored Channels with absent and explicit-empty servers each produce the root Server cell.
With no root Servers, one external-only membership produces both its indexed exclusion and the separate no-root-cell target without referent inference.
Reached non-map typed component containers have exact container owners while a usable sibling cell survives.
A multi-node pure Reference tail-cycle uses its first entered target while a malformed fragment charges its containing Operation owner.
UTF-16 wrong-kind and invalid-action values are invalid by precedence while a local usable sibling survives.
Shared malformed component and external Servers deduplicate once each and each otherwise usable operation separately receives S-05 after every candidate root slot is unusable.
A shared invalid component Operation and shared invalid external Channel repeat once per affected root operation while a good sibling survives.
One otherwise-valid UTF-16 external Server is deduplicated across root aliases and each usable operation separately receives S-05 after all root slots are encoding-excluded.
The minimal plaintext HTTP cell emits one exact empty-input operation and binding.
Explicit POST and binding version synthesize identically.
A server base path remains one represented cell.
Two HTTP servers emit two bindings and one operation.
HTTPS cell remains excluded
MQTT cell remains excluded
Missing operation HTTP binding remains excluded
Payload message remains excluded
One HTTP and one HTTPS server represent only HTTP.
Distinct root operations receive injective generated keys.
Explicit empty operation messages excludes the cell.
A referenced Message remains excluded.
Absent operations emits no ghost.
Mixed HTTP, WebSocket, and MQTT represents only HTTP.
A component operation is not inventoried beside represented root operation.
An explicit channel server subset yields only its represented cell.
C21 root slots resolving component values retain root identity
C21 canonical UTF-8 resourceBytes Operation and parsed external Channel/Server retain root cell identity
C21 escaped operation key preserves injective generated keys
C21 port and IPv6 servers synthesize distinct bindings
Explicit empty operation security remains represented and transform-free

Equal UTF-8 resource bytes at two retrieval origins retain distinct canonical invalid-owner sourceRefs
An invalid reached root Server key is an S02 owner and leaves the usable operation an S05 target.
Ordered duplicate direct memberships, one invalid root Server, and one BOM-less UTF-16 Server preserve distinct S06, S02, S07, and S05 evidence.
External invalid-owner sourceRef encoding leaves only unreserved, slash, and tilde bytes literal.

UTF-16 exclusion provenance survives a Reference Object hop into an otherwise valid UTF-8 Operation.

A portable high-surrogate root Operation key owns the root Operations container once.

An external Server alias that later traverses root slot s represents that root cell.
